{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Bay Gas Storage Extension''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/article/17262221/bay-gas-completes-whistler-gas-pipeline-in-alabama|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Bay Gas storage facility, McIntosh, Alabama to Whistler, Gulf South Pipeline interconnect, Alabama.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/article/17262221/bay-gas-completes-whistler-gas-pipeline-in-alabama|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''Bay Gas Storage Co Ltd<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/article/17262221/bay-gas-completes-whistler-gas-pipeline-in-alabama|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''43 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/article/17262221/bay-gas-completes-whistler-gas-pipeline-in-alabama|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''18 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/article/17262221/bay-gas-completes-whistler-gas-pipeline-in-alabama|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''24 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/article/17262221/bay-gas-completes-whistler-gas-pipeline-in-alabama|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/article/17262221/bay-gas-completes-whistler-gas-pipeline-in-alabama|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Start year: '''2001<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/article/17262221/bay-gas-completes-whistler-gas-pipeline-in-alabama|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
